_about: Hand-coded entries, batch 1. Each program carries its codes and the evidence behind each code. Notes are in the coder's own words. Codes marked needs_verify=true must be confirmed by the author before release.

reference_sources.title: 2 CFR 200.329 Monitoring and reporting program performance (eCFR)
reference_sources.note: Federal floor for all federal awards: periodic performance reports relating accomplishments to award objectives, no less than annually; final report within 120 days. Does not require baselines, outcome measurement, or independent verification. Source 89 FR 30136 (Apr. 22, 2024).

reference_sources.title: 2 CFR 200.301 Performance measurement (eCFR)
reference_sources.note: Agencies must measure performance; specifying outcomes, indicators, targets and baseline data in the award is recommended (should), not required.

programs.program_name: Energy Efficiency and Conservation Block Grant Program (IIJA)
programs.municipal_role: direct recipient (eligible local governments) or subrecipient via state
programs.asset_classes: buildings; street lighting; renewable energy; transportation

evidence.note: Recipients report one required primary metric per activity each quarter; IIJA metric set covers energy savings, cost savings, renewable generation and emissions reductions. Guidance does not require metered baselines or M&V, so metrics are treated as estimates.
Historical context: after GAO review, DOE stopped requiring ARRA-era recipients to calculate savings and instead estimated impacts centrally from reported activity data.

evidence.source: DOE, EECBG Award Management and Reporting page
evidence.note: Describes reports submitted to DOE; no public portal, dashboard or project-level outcome release found.
No baseline data requirement identified.

programs.program_name: Grid Resilience State and Tribal Formula Grants (IIJA 40101(d))

evidence.source: DOE, Grid Resilience Formula Grant Metrics Guidance Webinar slides (Oct 2023)
evidence.note: Build metrics (outputs) plus impact metrics including SAIDI, SAIFI, CAIDI and outage counts measured before and after implementation; annual report templates require baselining.
DOE submits a biennial report to Congress on grid resilience gains; no public release of subrecipient impact data located.
Pre and post reliability indices at project level; no comparison group.

programs.authority: Clean Water Act Title VI, 33 U.S.C. 1381 et seq.
programs.vehicle: capitalization grant to state revolving loan fund
programs.asset_classes: wastewater; stormwater; water and energy efficiency (Green Project Reserve)

evidence.note: Program results reported as assistance agreements, dollars and affordability reach; benefits reporting described only historically (ARRA modeled benefits, 2014 report). No energy outcome requirement identified.

evidence.source: ASDWA, EPA unveils SRF Public Dashboards and Public Portal
evidence.note: SRF Public Portal offers downloadable project-specific reports from 2021 onward; outcome fields not confirmed.
No baseline or outcome measurement requirement identified.

programs.program_name: Solar for All (Greenhouse Gas Reduction Fund)
programs.vehicle: competitive grant to states, municipalities, tribes, nonprofits
programs.municipal_role: direct recipient (municipalities eligible); subrecipient via state programs
programs.status_note: EPA announced on Aug. 7, 2025 it would no longer implement the program, citing repeal of authority and rescission of remaining funds. On Sept. 18, 2026 the U.S. District Court for the District of Rhode Island vacated the termination. Further proceedings possible.

evidence.note: Aug. 7, 2025 announcement that EPA would no longer implement the program.

evidence.source: CT Mirror, Solar for All termination ruled illegal (Sept. 18, 2026)
evidence.note: D.R.I. vacated the termination as contrary to congressional intent for obligated grants.

evidence.source: EPA, Solar for All household savings highlights (archived Jan. 19, 2025 snapshot)
evidence.note: Selectees committed to at least 20 percent household savings; page gives no measurement method. A coalition contractor RFP describes expected savings verified by sample audits, consistent with estimated outcomes.
No public outcome data located.

evidence.source: CESA, IPC RFP Impact Reporting and Household Savings (2025)
evidence.note: No baseline requirement stated; savings described as expected.

programs.program_name: Congestion Mitigation and Air Quality Improvement Program
programs.agency: U.S. Department of Transportation, FHWA and FTA
programs.municipal_role: project sponsor via state DOT or MPO

evidence.source: Data.gov, CMAQ Public Access System dataset record
evidence.note: States submit annual project-level obligation reports each March. Statutory annual report includes estimated emission reductions per project (23 U.S.C. 149(i)); confirm field in a PAS export.
Public, project-level, U.S. government work, updated annually (dataset last updated 2026-09-16). Coded C3 on the expectation that estimated emissions benefits are shown per project.
Benefits are ex ante estimates against a modeled no-build case; no measured outcome or comparison group.

programs.program_name: National Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Formula Program
programs.authority: IIJA Div. J, Title VIII; 23 CFR part 680
programs.municipal_role: subrecipient or site host via state DOT
programs.status_note: Suspended by FHWA in Feb. 2025; revised guidance issued Aug. 2025; about $503.8 million rescinded in Jan. 2026; spacing requirements removed Feb. 2026.

evidence.note: Quarterly metered operating data per port: sessions, kWh dispensed, peak power, uptime and outage minutes; annual maintenance cost; one-time capital and grid cost data.
Any public release must be aggregated and anonymized. A national public aggregate release has not been confirmed.
Measures station performance, not program outcomes against a counterfactual such as EV adoption or emissions.

evidence.source: Atlas Public Policy, NEVI Status Update Fact Sheet (July 2026)
evidence.note: Suspension, revised guidance, rescission and spacing change as summarized in status_note.

evidence.locator: paragraph (c) names 23 U.S.C. 151(f) grants; (a)-(b) apply to direct recipients
evidence.note: Same metered data submittal applies to funded charging stations.
Aggregated release only, not confirmed.
